ja.description: 変な振動で、起こします。仮眠や寝かしつけの寝落ち対策に。変化する振動、複数回のお知らせ、計算やタップによる停止操作を備えたアプリです。

短い振動、長い振動、連打するリズム。

ja.faqTitle: 使う前に、知っておきたいこと。
faq: iPhoneをロックしたまま使えますか？
アプリ独自の振動パターンを使うには、ナイト画面を開いたまま待機してください。ロック中や他のアプリを使っている間はiOS側の制御になり、選んだ振動パターンや強さは適用されません。
音は鳴りますか？
アラームは音の代わりに振動で知らせる設計です。リラックス音は自分でオンにしたときだけ再生します。振動が机や寝具に伝わる音、端末設定による動作の違いはあるため、使う場所と端末で事前にお試しください。
無料でどこまで使えますか？
基本4種類の振動、標準の複数回アラーム、停止・スヌーズ、ナイト画面、リラックス音、ライトを利用できます。回数や間隔、停止手順の変更、自作パターン、広告の非表示はプレミアムです。
アカウント登録は必要ですか？
アプリ専用のアカウント登録は不要です。設定や予定は端末に保存します。広告・解析・購入に関するデータの扱いは、プライバシーポリシーをご確認ください。
使い始めに何を確認すればよいですか？
アプリの案内に沿って必要な権限を許可し、「権限・動作確認」で試してください。Androidでは端末の省電力設定も動作に影響する場合があります。通知の到達や起床を保証するものではありません。

en.name: Nap & Stay Awake
en.title: Nap & Stay Awake | Vibration alarms for naps and bedtime
en.description: Wake up to unusual vibrations. Changing vibration patterns, multiple reminders and math or tapping tasks for naps and getting back up after settling your child.
en.headline:
Wake up to
unusual vibrations.
en.audience:
For when a short nap turns into a long sleep.
Or you fall asleep while settling your child.

Short pulses, long pulses and bursts.
Changing vibrations, multiple reminders and
math or tapping tasks in one alarm app.

en.heroCaption: Choose a duration or a wake-up time
en.vTitle:
Short pulses. Long pulses.
Bursts. A changing rhythm.
en.vBenefit: Changing lengths and rhythms feel different from your everyday notifications. That unfamiliar feeling is designed to help you notice the alarm and wake up.
en.vBody: The app combines patterns with changes in duration and spacing. Choose from four modes: Random, Notification Mix, Mostly Long and Mostly Short.
en.vFoot: Try the vibrations in the app before choosing a pattern.
en.repeatBody: No need to create each alarm separately. Stop the current reminder and wait for the next one, or finish the remaining set once you are up.
en.repeatFoot: Adjusting the number of reminders and their spacing requires Premium.
en.repeatDiagram: From setup to finishing the set
en.repeatDiagramNote: An illustration of a set with three reminders.
en.stopTitle:
Solve or tap
to stop the alarm.
en.stopBody: Solve a calculation, tap numbers in order, hold or tap repeatedly. Stopping the alarm involves actions that use your mind and hands.
en.stopFoot: Standard stop and snooze tasks are free. Editing and combining the steps requires Premium.
en.nightTitle:
Set your alarm.
Wait with a dim screen.
en.nightBody: Adjust the brightness and clock display in Night Screen. You can also hide the display while waiting and tap to see the clock again.
how: Choose a time
Use a duration such as 30 minutes, or set the time you want to wake up.
Wait with Night Screen
Dim the screen. Turn on relaxing sounds or light only if you want them.
Finish when you are up
Complete the stop tasks and finish the remaining reminders you no longer need.
en.iosTitle: On iPhone, keep the screen unlocked.
en.iosBody: Keep Night Screen open to use custom vibrations. Locking with the side button or switching apps puts vibration under iOS control; your chosen pattern and strength will not apply. A black Night Screen is not the same as locking your phone.
en.scheduleTitle: Repeat on the days you choose.
en.scheduleBody: Set a time and weekdays for recurring alarms, such as every day or workdays.
en.relaxBody: For naps or settling your child. Turn either on from Night Screen whenever you need it.
en.soundTitle: Rain or waves, at your volume.
en.soundBody: Choose rain, waves or white noise. The sound fades out before the first reminder and stops by the time vibration begins.
en.lightTitle: A screen light for nighttime care.
en.lightBody: For feeds or checking on your child at night. Choose warm, pale red or pale white light, then adjust the screen brightness.
en.relaxFoot: Relaxing sounds and light are both free.
en.relaxAlt: Night Screen relaxing sound and light controls, with light color and brightness settings
en.priceBody: Try the vibrations and stop tasks. Choose Premium if you want more control.
en.priceFoot: Premium offers a monthly plan or a one-time purchase. See the in-app purchase screen for prices. Monthly subscriptions renew automatically; manage or cancel them in your store account settings.
faq: Can I lock my iPhone while using the app?
Keep Night Screen open to use the app’s custom vibration patterns. While your phone is locked or another app is open, iOS controls vibration and your chosen pattern and strength will not apply.
Does the app play sound?

The alarm is designed to use vibration instead of an alarm tone. Relaxing sounds play only when you turn them on. Vibration can make noise against a desk or bedding, and device settings can affect behavior. Test it where you plan to use it.
What can I use for free?

Four vibration modes, standard multiple reminders, stop and snooze tasks, Night Screen, relaxing sounds and light. Adjusting reminder count and spacing, editing stop tasks, creating patterns and removing ads require Premium.
Do I need an account?
No app-specific account is required. Settings and schedules are stored on your device. See the privacy policy for information about data used for advertising, analytics and purchases.
What should I check before using it?
Follow the app’s introduction to allow the required permissions, then try Permissions & Test. Android battery-saving settings may affect operation. Alarm delivery and waking are not guaranteed.

ฟังเสียงฝน คลื่น หรือไวต์นอยส์ เสียงจะเริ่มเมื่อคุณเปิดเองเท่านั้น และค่อย ๆ เบาลงจนหยุดเมื่อถึงการปลุกครั้งแรก เลือกแสงโทนอุ่น แดงอ่อน หรือขาวนวล แล้วปรับความสว่าง

การสั่นสั้น ยาว และต่อเนื่องให้ความรู้สึกต่างจากการแจ้งเตือนทั่วไป เป็นสัญญาณช่วยให้ตื่น
แก้โจทย์คำนวณสั้น ๆ เพื่อหยุดปลุก การใช้ความคิดและมืออาจช่วยให้ตื่นตัวขึ้น
หรี่หน้าจอระหว่างพัก จะเปิดเสียงหรือแสงเพิ่มตอนงีบหรือกล่อมลูกนอนก็ได้
